title: CB2-S2 (r4): outcome-based improvement of the accepted high-level controller r3h-B, executor fixed
authority: DAV-91: protocol drafted by Claude, approved in principle by Sol with guardrails (PPO + KL anchored to frozen r3h-B; 'outlive the routine' as completion; S2-progress label; one-sided 95% lower bound), David approved proceeding (2026-10-09)

reference.what: frozen candidates/r3h-B: initial policy, KL anchor, rollback point (also installed and marked stable in cb2-ind-0001)

fixed: the scripted executor organ, the r2 core (frozen), the vision organ v1, the language stand-in; only the selector (and a value head) learns

learner.algorithm: PPO over the 8 organ commands, one command per step, + beta*KL(pi||pi_r3hB) per step + entropy bonus
learner.value_head: MLP on the detached selector trunk
learner.beta_rule: x2 if the iteration's mean KL to r3h-B > 1.5 * 0.02; /2 if < 0.02 / 1.5
learner.early_stop: an update stops when the approximate KL to the rollout policy exceeds 0.05
learner.sampling: temperature 1, a pure function of (iteration, life, step)

reward: the environment's own reward['total'] = Crafter (+1 per new unlock, +-0.1 per health point) + caretaker (+1 fulfilled, -1 failed/late); no shaping, no survival bonus; not tuned after seeing results

red_flags_reported: training reward rising while development survival or requests fall

development.when: r3h-B before training (iteration 0) and every 5 iterations, greedy (temperature 0)
development.selection: the checkpoint with the best mean development survival among those whose development Crafter score >= r3h-B's; if none is eligible: no candidate, the sealed set is not opened

arms: S2 candidate (paired with the routine on the same worlds, unchanged cb2_evaluate protocol)
sealed.bootstrap: paired per-world differences; one-sided 95% lower bound = 5th percentile of 10,000 bootstrap means, numpy default_rng(20261009)

verdicts.S2_complete_beyond_routine: all of: (1) lower bound of paired survival (S2 - routine) > 0; (2) Crafter score >= 1.0x routine; (3) requests on time >= 0.85x the routine's rate (aggregate counts); (4) continuity as in r3-H (integrity, save/restore, consolidation round-trip, replay of 90041, 100% delegation provenance); no protocol deviation
verdicts.S2_progress: if not complete: lower bound of paired survival (S2 - r3h-B) > 0 AND score >= r3h-B's score on the same worlds AND (3) AND (4)
verdicts.no_improvement: otherwise (reported as such; no post-hoc retuning on the sealed set)

integrity: any crash, missing world, corrupted artifact or protocol deviation is reported as such, never silently rerun
gate4: OPEN: S2 does not address prediction / persistent memory
